_doc: Cross-investor rulings for COLLECTION.md invariant 10 (run.py verify), scoped to this investor and merged at read time with data/collection/cross-investor.json. Written during the PRO-93 First Round run, 2026-09-06; the shared file is touched only at wave alignment (§12). First Round's book is unusually collision-prone because the firm names a large share of its companies with a single common word (Clay, Level, Cover, Haven, Gem, Swell, Superb, Hem, Drift, Revel, Maven, Whisper, Parallel, Prepared, Petual, Open, Limitless), which is the same property that broke the Wikidata layer for this investor (scratch/gate.md).
